case_title.correct_value: Asim Shariff v. National Investigation Agency
case_title.quote: ASIM SHARIFF v. NATIONAL INVESTIGATION AGENCY
case_title.reason: Spelling of the appellant's surname is wrong ('Shariiff'); the rest of the title matches.

number_of_accused.reason: Judgment refers to the appellant along with four other accused, i.e. five in total.

accused_gender.reason: Appellant referred to with male pronoun ('his discharge'); male is supported.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused appears in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religion of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste of the accused is stated.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states appellant is President of the Bengaluru unit of PFI.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status is not stated in the judgment.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record of the accused is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim referred to as male ('his throat was slit').

victim_religion.reason: Victim's religion is not stated; only RSS membership is mentioned.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: Admittedly, there is no animosity between the appellant and deceased.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment mentions no animosity but never states the relationship as 'stranger'.

offence_category.reason: Charges include IPC s.302 (murder) and the death is the central offence.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 120-B, 109, 150, 153A, 302, 201 read with Section 34 of IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits IPC ss.120B, 109, 150, 153A, 201 and UAP ss.16(1)(a) and 17.

weapon.reason: Machete described as the weapon used in the hacking.

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial and documentary/recovery evidence (banner, call records, letter), plus alleged confession by accused no. 4
evidence_type.reason: No medical evidence is discussed; evidence is prosecution-alleged and largely circumstantial or documentary.

confession.correct_value: Prosecution alleges accused no. 4 confessed appellant was the mastermind; court made no finding on it
confession.quote: Accused no. 4 confesses that accused appellant was the mastermind behind the killing of RSS members.
confession.reason: This is a prosecution contention recorded in arguments, not an established confession.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Prosecution contends conspiracy and intent to create fear and insecurity; court made no aggravating finding
aggravating_circumstances.quote: to create fear in the minds of the people at large and to create insecurity and foster disharmony
aggravating_circumstances.reason: These are prosecution submissions, not court-identified aggravating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The application filed under Section 227 Cr.P.C. by the accused No.5 is hereby dismissed.
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court dismissed discharge application and ordered framing of charges.

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court after analysing the entire material on record confirmed the view expressed by the trial Judge
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the writ petition, affirming the trial court.

final_outcome.correct_value: Not stated (no conviction; discharge refused, charges framed, trial to proceed)
final_outcome.quote: we find no error in the judgment passed by the trial Court and confirmed by the High Court
final_outcome.reason: Judgment is only about discharge; no conviction. The Court directed trial to proceed independently.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Not stated (only prima facie case of conspiracy found)
offence_finally_established.quote: there is a prima facie material of conspiracy among the accused persons
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established; only prima facie material for framing charges was found.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence was imposed, so no imprisonment type is stated.

imprisonment_years.reason: No imprisonment term is stated in the judgment.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is stated in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts presented as prosecution allegations (conspiracy, PFI membership, prior killings, recovered banner and letter) rather than established facts
neutral_facts.quote: The investigation revealed that the accused were members of a group involved in previous killings of RSS members.
neutral_facts.reason: Prosecution contentions are stated as established facts; the summary does not reveal the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Sentencing ranges for s.302 and s.120B do not appear in the judgment.

attempt_completion.quote: Rudresh was taken to a hospital wherein he was declared brought dead.
attempt_completion.reason: The murder was completed; the victim was declared dead.

physical_harm.quote: hacked Rudresh with a sharp edged and lethal machete on the right side of his neck
physical_harm.reason: Death caused by machete hacking is stated in the judgment.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Multiple offences charged under IPC ss.120B, 109, 150, 153A, 302, 201 r/w 34; Arms Act ss.3, 27; UAP Act ss.15, 16(1)(a), 17, 18, 20; charges framed, none finally established
number_of_offences.quote: Sections 120-B, 109, 150, 153A, 302, 201 read with Section 34 of IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Count of 5 matches accused number, not offences; more provisions are charged; none finally upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed in the judgment.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Prima facie conspiracy among accused found; truth to be examined at trial; no final finding of premeditation
premeditation_planning.quote: truth & veracity of such conspiracy is to be examined during the course of trial
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found only prima facie conspiracy, not a final finding of premeditation or planning.

motive.correct_value: Prosecution alleges conspiracy to kill RSS members and strike terror; no animosity with deceased
motive.quote: conspired with the accused appellant(accused no. 5) to kill RSS members
motive.reason: The judgment states an alleged motive of killing RSS members to spread terror, so 'Not identified' is inaccurate.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Charge-sheet material (PFI membership, frequent phone contacts) found to give prima facie grounds; truth to be tested at trial
key_evidence_accepted.quote: giving rise to sufficient grounds of subjective satisfaction of prima facie case
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Material was accepted only for prima facie purposes at discharge stage, not as proven evidence.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Not stated (court did not assess witness credibility; defence contended witnesses implicated appellant nothing)
witness_credibility.quote: did not whisper anything against the appellant
witness_credibility.reason: Witness-related point is the defence submission; court made no credibility assessment, and the HC-credibility claim is not in the judgment.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is discussed.

custody_duration.reason: Arrest dates are given but no custody duration is stated.

trial_duration.correct_value: Crime registered 16 Oct 2016; discharge refused 2 Jan 2018 (charge order 12 Jan 2018 per para 21); HC 22 Nov 2018; SC 1 Jul 2019; trial not concluded
trial_duration.reason: Calls the order a 'trial judgment' and omits the 12 January 2018 date given elsewhere; trial is ongoing.

legal_representation.quote: Kamini Jaiswal, Abdul Rahiman, Shereef K.A., Ms. Rani Mishra, Jatinderpal Singh., Advs. for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for both sides match the judgment.

investigation_status.correct_value: Investigation complete; charge sheet filed 21 April 2017; trial pending with charges framed
investigation_status.quote: proceed with the trial independently in accordance with law
investigation_status.reason: Charge sheet date is correct, but the trial is not completed; it is to proceed.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Court notes no procedural irregularity; defence arguments were not accepted as irregularities.

appeal_history.quote: With these observations, the appeal is dismissed.
appeal_history.reason: Trial court dismissed discharge, HC affirmed, and SC dismissed the appeal.

prosecution_argument.quote: the trial Court rightly held that the prima facie case was made out against the appellant
prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the ASG's submissions on prima facie material and correct framing of charges.

defence_argument.quote: the charge against the appellant is without any basis and merely on suspicion
defence_argument.reason: Matches defence submissions on lack of material, suspicion-based charge, and miscarriage of justice.

legal_principle_applied.quote: where the material placed before the Court discloses grave suspicion against the accused which has not been properly explained, the Court will be fully justified in framing the charge
legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the court's stated principle on sifting evidence and grave suspicion under s.227.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All four cases and citations match the judgment's list of authorities.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing occurred, so no sentencing rationale is stated.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The court identifies no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court makes no aggravating-factor finding.

other_sentence_order.reason: No other sentence order is made.
